name: Finn Sharke
source:
Finn is a rich second-generation shark who is a local tyrant. He owns several businesses, making a profit by lending money at high-interest rates. In other words, he's a through-and-through loan shark, though he dislikes being called one.

He falls in love with the protagonist at first glance, which causes him to become laxer and more generous with Banana Ranch's debt.
